source_urls_and_locators.limitation: The chapter defines a network to be connected; disconnected componentwise use needs separate scoping.
The sourced network is connected. Version 1's same-component extension is a conservative scoped computation.
Connected-network theorem; hitting times can be asymmetric.
The section assumes a connected undirected graph.
Disconnected handling is obtained directly from the absence of spanning trees and Laplacian nullity, not from the connected theorem statement.
The theorem quantifies edges of a connected graph; it does not license a nonedge probability by inventing a weight.
